name: Wide Plank Hardwood in Mercer Island Homes: Special Considerations
title-tag: Wide Plank Hardwood Floors: A Mercer Island, WA Guide
meta-description: Wide plank moves more, shows more, and forgives less. A Mercer Island contractor on sanding, gaps, engineered wear layers, and finishes for 5-inch-plus boards.
post-summary: November 6, 2026 · Wide plank refinishes beautifully, but boards 5 inches and up move more with the seasons, show every flatness error, and reject the gap-filling tricks that work on strip floors. What changes at width — sanding, filler, engineered wear layers, finishes — plus the Mercer Island humidity factor.
